title: Notice regarding non-availability of Hon'ble Mr.Justice Vimal K. Vyas on 23.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 23/11/2026

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 23/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 23.11.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Vimal K. Vyas would not be available.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Ms. Justice S. V .Pinto)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Vimal K.
Vyas.)
By Order of Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
